comments.author: CruelAngelsThesaurus
comments.body:
It'll pass the alpha?

I'm going to try to be as civil about this as I can so don't misread my tone but.

You can't cheat good design practice no matter how hard you prompt, only you know what's going to actually be fun for the player. You can't just throw a bunch of assets in a blender and call it a game, it wont float that way.

Your UI is fine, you didn't make that, it's just grafted from every fifa game, it'd be more impressive if you somehow cooked it. The character blow ass but that's something that can be worked on. It just feels like you kinda said "Hey make me the most background character lookin dudes from every Yaoi anime and leave it at that. But it's forgivable.

My big grip comes in at the gameplay, who tf is going to want to have to sit through those jarring cutaways, slow ass snails animation etc etc in place of any actual on screen reaction? Did you even playtest this rigorously or did you just throw on the first clip of you doing anything and say "Oh yeah that's it" Cause I assure you, it's not.

I saw your progress posts few times and i truly can see your passion in making this game. There is few points that you can improve to make it more stunning and being differents than other football games:  
\- People play football games because of real football players. For sure, you cannot put a Messi or Neymar in your game. In this case just make each player sprite memorable, since you have skill tree and supernatural elements in your gameplay. With AI, try to make a character with futuric vibe, a robot or a post apocalypse character design. Its more works but it worth.   
\- there is a bit of style mismatch between the UI and actual gameplay, one is clean art, theother is pixel art. Some players wont care much but it is still an important thing worth fixing.
